description: This file defines the IResourceManager interface within the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace. It declares methods for managing audio/video blocking, retrieving blocked applications, and reserving TTS resources, along with associated result structures and type definitions.

classes.name: IResourceManager
classes.description: Interface for resource management operations such as AV blocking and TTS resource reservation.

methods.name: SetAVBlocked
methods.description: Sets the AV blocking status for a specified application.

methods.name: GetBlockedAVApplications
methods.description: Retrieves a list of applications with blocked AV access.

methods.name: ReserveTTSResource
methods.description: Reserves TTS resource for a single application.

methods.name: ReserveTTSResourceForApps
methods.description: Reserves TTS resources for multiple applications.

calls: Core::hresult SetAVBlocked(const string&, const bool, SetAVBlockedResult&)
